segments.source: Single-boiler ownership rewards a written routine. Warm the group and portafilter, keep the dose and yield visible, purge condensation before milk, wipe and purge the wand immediately, then refill or cool the boiler as the manual directs. Skipping the return-to-brew step can create confusing temperature behavior and, on some designs, unnecessary stress.

Confirm local warranty and paid service before purchase; a conventional layout can be repairable without guaranteeing local parts or affordable labor.
